name: Virginia DPOR Contractor and Tradesmen License Lookup

agency.name: Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation

updateFrequency: unknown; verify the official lookup and DPOR board material before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Virginia DPOR contractor firm licenses, classes, classifications, specialties, and contractor-board tradesmen records exposed by the public lookup
knownExclusions: The lookup is not modeled as a confirmed bulk public dataset.
This source does not represent every local permit, business registration, or non-DPOR construction authorization in Virginia.
DPOR asbestos, lead, and home inspector records are tracked separately under the asbestos board source.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Any future automated access must account for the official lookup disclaimer and technical controls.
publicRecordsNotes: Official lookup source metadata only. The DPOR lookup includes its own legal disclaimer; absence from this source is not proof that a license does not exist elsewhere.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official bulk download has been confirmed in this phase.
researchNotes: Registry-only blocked source for now because the official path is lookup-oriented and no stable machine-readable public export contract has been confirmed.
maintainerNotes: Future adapter work should preserve DPOR disclaimer wording, source URL, checked time, caveats, and raw lookup evidence before exposing records.

researchEvidence.note: DPOR states that the Board for Contractors licenses businesses engaged in construction, removal, repair, or improvement of facilities and uses license class plus classification or specialty to determine authorized work.
DPOR states that the Board for Contractors regulates individual tradesmen including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, gas fitting, water well construction, and related trades.
Board for Contractors regulations define commercial, residential, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, home improvement, swimming pool, and related specialty/classification scopes.

blocker.summary: No stable, documented machine-readable official interface is currently suitable for an offline-tested adapter.

termsReviewNotes: DPOR lookup disclaimer and site terms were identified, but source-specific publication and redistribution approval has not been completed.
officialLookupReviewNotes: DPOR publishes a public license lookup and board pages for contractor firms, classes, classifications, specialties, and tradesmen regulated by the Board for Contractors.
verificationCaveats: This source covers DPOR Board for Contractors records exposed by the official lookup and related board pages.
No matching record means no match in the checked source at the checked time, not proof that a Virginia license, permit, trade credential, or local authorization does not exist.
verificationNotes: No supported sync or verification adapter is exposed while the official lookup contract and allowed reuse remain under review.
